mapper.sql: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_operation_log l WHERE l.biz_type='CUSTOMER' AND l.biz_id=c.id AND l.old_owner_id=#{s.userId} AND l.ownership_seq=c.ownership_seq AND l.handover_readonly_until > #{now})

SELECT c.id,c.customer_name, CASE WHEN c.sea_type='PUBLIC' THEN CASE WHEN c.primary_phone IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(c.primary_phone)>=7 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(c.primary_phone,3),'****',RIGHT(c.primary_phone,4)) ELSE '****' END ELSE c.primary_phone END AS primary_phone, CASE WHEN c.sea_type='PUBLIC' THEN CASE WHEN p.contact_name IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(p.contact_name,1),'**') END ELSE p.contact_name END AS primary_contact_name, c.source_code,c.industry_code,c.customer_level,c.tags_json,c.region,c.customer_status,c.sea_type, c.owner_id,c.team_id,u.real_name AS owner_name,t.team_name,c.version, CASE WHEN c.sea_type='PUBLIC' THEN 1 WHEN THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS readonly, CASE WHEN c.sea_type='PUBLIC' THEN 10 WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS can_edit FROM crm_customer c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=c.owner_id LEFT JOIN sys_team t ON t.id=c.team_id LEFT JOIN crm_contact p ON p.primary_customer_id=c.id
